limitations: The closed Codex response profile accepts only an MCP structuredContent object. Text content, JSON-looking prose, top-level result wrappers, and string-valued structured results fail with STRUCTURED_RESPONSE_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE and are never parsed.

The Codex response profile is a normalization contract, not a current live-route claim. Current Codex and Claude Slack message and thread routes expose formatted prose, so Slack Conversation Review connected acquisition is unavailable.
Slack Channel Ingestion uses separate conversation-identity and participant capabilities. Those live routes remain declared but unverified; this correction neither promotes nor disables them.
Connected reads use a Core-checkpointed bounded cursor sequence. Only cursor-exhausted aggregates become portable capability output; page cursors remain private current-call arguments.
Direct messages are modeled by the portable conversation contract but excluded by the first Slack Conversation Review Automation policy.
Native provider responses, cursors, workspace values, participant data, and message content remain private and are never persisted as canonical artifacts or general inspection data.
No Slack write, reaction, reply, send, archive, dispatch, or destructive capability is declared.
